'''Ulklub''' was a [[Temperature/Legends|hot]] rock [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with no [[Moon/Legends|moons]] that occupied the closest [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position to the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Opoku]]. It was located within the [[Gamorr system/Legends|Opoku system]],<ref name="TEA" /> a part of the [[Galov sector/Legends|Galov sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> within the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions known as the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. The [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] connected Ulklub to the [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] of [[Arami system/Legends|Arami]] and [[Lyran system/Legends|Lyran]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ulklub was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the Opoku [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Ulklub, in grid square T-14.<ref name="TEA" />
